title: GRPO Training Dynamics for Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.39321v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has emerged as a memory-efficient reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) technique for reasoning-intensive tasks. How- ever, GRPO training dynamics on small language models (SLMs) remain poorly understood, limiting its reliable adoption and reproducibility in open and resource- constrained environments. In this work, we present a systematic study of GRPO fine-tuning for SLMs ranging from 1.5B to 7B parameters under a practical single- node 8xA100 compute budget. Our study spans multiple model families and reasoning domains, including mathematics, coding, and multiple-choice question answering (MCQ) in science. Across these settings, we analyze how group size affects policy convergence, training stability, and downstream benchmark per- formance. translated_title: 面向小型语言模型的GRPO训练动态研究
translated_abstract: 组相对策略优化（GRPO）已成为一种面向推理密集型任务的高效内存强化微调（RFT）技术。然而，GRPO在小型语言模型（SLM）上的训练动态仍未被充分理解，这限制了它在开放和资源受限环境中被可靠采用和复现。在本工作中，我们在实际的单节点8xA100计算预算下，对参数量从1.5B到7B的小型语言模型的GRPO微调进行了系统性研究。我们的研究涵盖多个模型家族和推理领域，包括数学、编程以及科学领域的多项选择题（MCQ）。在这些设置中，我们分析了组大小如何影响策略收敛、训练稳定性和下游基准性能。我们进一步刻画了GRPO训练过程中的张量级更新动态，并研究了LoRA目标模块和层的选择能否改进……
tldr: 本研究在单节点8xA100的实际算力约束下，系统性地研究了1.5B至7B参数小型语言模型的GRPO微调训练动态，涵盖数学、编程和科学选择题等多个推理领域，分析组大小对策略收敛、训练稳定性和下游性能的影响，并刻画张量级更新动态及LoRA目标模块选择的改进作用。
en_tdlr: This work systematically studies GRPO fine-tuning dynamics for 1.5B–7B small language models under a practical single-node 8xA100 compute budget, covering math, coding, and science MCQ domains, analyzing how group size affects policy convergence, training stability, and downstream performance, while characterizing tensor-level update dynamics and investigating LoRA target module selection.
